comment: PBR description for hero_character_skin (C-13). The Q4 harness now draws this cell on a procedural skinned mesh with a host linear-blend pose, so the material is exercised on a deforming surface.
surface: worn woven character-suit surface, intended for a skinned mesh

skinnedPath.why: the Q4 harness draws this cell on a 12-bone procedural humanoid (805 vertices, 2-bone linear blend, 4 influences per vertex) and advances the pose with the frame index; a retail or engine rig remains outside the 009 material contract

metalness.why: woven suit fabric is a dielectric; no metal is modelled in this cell

ao.why: no baked AO authored for this cell; AO is not synthesised from the albedo
